SELECT mwap.*, product.id AS 'product.id', product.serial_number AS 'product.serial_number', product.specification AS 'product.specification', product.net_weight AS 'product.net_weight', pq.quantity AS 'product.quantity' FROM mes_wage_adjust_product mwap
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact product ON product.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND product.id = mwap.product_id AND mwap.product_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, monomer_id, serial_number, sum(quantity) AS quantity FROM tech_artifact WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY project_id, monomer_id, serial_number ) pq ON pq.project_id = mwap.project_id AND pq.monomer_id = mwap.monomer_id AND pq.serial_number = mwap.product_serial_number
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble product ON product.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND product.id = mwap.product_id AND mwap.product_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ASSEMBLE.getType()} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, monomer_id, serial_number, sum(quantity) AS quantity FROM tech_assemble WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY project_id, monomer_id, serial_number ) pq ON pq.project_id = mwap.project_id AND pq.monomer_id = mwap.monomer_id AND pq.serial_number = mwap.product_serial_number
LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part product ON product.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND product.id = mwap.product_id AND mwap.product_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@MACHINE_PART.getType()} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, monomer_id, serial_number, sum(quantity) AS quantity FROM tech_machine_part WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY project_id, monomer_id, serial_number ) pq ON pq.project_id = mwap.project_id AND pq.monomer_id = mwap.monomer_id AND pq.serial_number = mwap.product_serial_number
WHERE mwap.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mwap.wage_adjust_id = #{wageAdjustId} AND mwap.product_type_enum = #{productTypeEnum}

SELECT mwap.*, product.id AS 'product.id', product.serial_number AS 'product.serial_number', product.specification AS 'product.specification', product.net_weight AS 'product.net_weight', pq.quantity AS 'product.quantity', mwa.workshop_id, mwa.process_id, mwa.team_ids FROM mes_wage_adjust_product mwap LEFT JOIN mes_wage_adjust mwa ON mwa.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mwa.id = mwap.wage_adjust_id
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact product ON product.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND product.id = mwap.product_id AND mwap.product_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, monomer_id, serial_number, sum(quantity) AS quantity FROM tech_artifact WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY project_id, monomer_id, serial_number ) pq ON pq.project_id = mwap.project_id AND pq.monomer_id = mwap.monomer_id AND pq.serial_number = mwap.product_serial_number
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble product ON product.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND product.id = mwap.product_id AND mwap.product_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ASSEMBLE.getType()} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, monomer_id, serial_number, sum(quantity) AS quantity FROM tech_assemble WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY project_id, monomer_id, serial_number ) pq ON pq.project_id = mwap.project_id AND pq.monomer_id = mwap.monomer_id AND pq.serial_number = mwap.product_serial_number
LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part product ON product.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND product.id = mwap.product_id AND mwap.product_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@MACHINE_PART.getType()} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, monomer_id, serial_number, sum(quantity) AS quantity FROM tech_machine_part WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY project_id, monomer_id, serial_number ) pq ON pq.project_id = mwap.project_id AND pq.monomer_id = mwap.monomer_id AND pq.serial_number = mwap.product_serial_number
WHERE mwap.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mwa.approval_status = #{approvalStatus} AND mwap.product_type_enum = #{productTypeEnum}
#{item}
ORDER BY mwap.id DESC
